v3.2.0: Pure GitHub API, remove Zread/GitView, fix ClawHub security audit

Changes:
- Remove all zread.ai references (code + docs)
- Remove GitView local service references
- Delete nested github-reader/ legacy directory
- Remove unverified security self-checklist
- Pure GitHub REST API as only data source
- Tighten trigger patterns (explicit owner/repo only)
- Privacy notice in output (data flow transparency)
- SECURITY.md claims mapped to specific functions
- Fix all 16 ClawHub security audit issues

GitHub Reader Skill 3.0.0 introduces comprehensive structured GitHub project reports and enhanced automation.

- 自动识别任何 GitHub URL 并生成结构化报告
- 输出包括项目概览、核心价值、主要功能、架构亮点、快速开始指南和建议阅读顺序
- 新增集成 Zread 深度解读和 GitView 快速概览链接
- 支持自然语言和命令两种触发方式
- 项目属性采用格式化显示，包含相对时间
- 配置选项支持自动 URL 检测
